note:
Measured by tests/e2e/design-census.spec.ts against the running product. Sprawl counts may fall and never rise; contrast readings may rise and never fall. Rewrite with UPDATE_CENSUS=1 npm run census, and say why in the commit.

T-0117 corrected how contentLeft is read, so the three geometry numbers are not comparable to the ones U0 committed. contentLeft was the COMMONEST left among painted blocks inside <main>, which is a vote: /results/logs paints hundreds of log lines inside its terminal pane and elected the pane's inner left; /work/missions elected an <h2> that outnumbered the cards it sits in, by exactly those cards' padding. It is now the LEFTMOST outermost painted block that is not the page's own ground. Re-measured on the tree U0 baselined, that reads worstHeadingOffset 237 across 23 of 23 routes, not 289 across 21 - the old instrument understated both the size and the reach of the defect. distinctHeadingLefts (7 there, 1 here) was added in the same batch because it states cause 2 without a heuristic at all: how many different x the product's h1 sits at. distinctButtonHeights fell by one for the same kind of reason - a control that is inline in a sentence has a line box, not a height, which the hit-target measure already knew and this one did not.

T-0118 is the surface batch, and these readings are its result rather than an instrument change. The rail moved from 1.06:1 against the page to 1.47:1 and its seam from 1.26:1 to 4.40:1, which is the operator's headline complaint answered in the only terms it can be checked in. controlBordersBelowThree halved, 320 to 156, and every one of the 156 that remain is accent-tinted: colour that means armed, selected or failed, which is the status ladder's and is U6. decorativeBordersBelowThree does not go to zero by design - the hairline rung is 1.63:1 on purpose, because a card whose fill already sits 1.47:1 off the page does not also need a 3:1 stroke - so read it as a count of boundaries nobody can see rather than of boundaries below a target.

allowed.reason: T-0119. All four follow from one intended change and all four are U8's to take back. (1) decorativeBordersBelowThree +37: the 32 section headings gained the hairline rule that makes a heading read as one. The hairline is 1.63:1 BY CONSTRUCTION and clears the 1.55 floor the live gate holds; this metric's floor is 3:1, which the ladder deliberately does not meet for a card outline, so the number punishes doing the right thing and should be re-cut in U16. (2) distinctButtonHeights +7, and the two chrome counts with it, because a chrome key carries its height: button labels rose from 12px to 14px, which is the register decision, and this product has no button height scale at all - every height is whatever its label makes it. The Button primitive's three fixed heights are U8.
